hook.en: A clock’s minute hand goes round sixty times for every single turn of the hour hand. A loop inside another loop works the same way.

objectives.en: Explain how a nested loop executes
Count the iterations of nested loops

narration.en: A clock’s minute hand goes round sixty times for every single turn of the hour hand. A loop inside another loop works the same way.
narration.kn: ಗಡಿಯಾರದ ಗಂಟೆ ಮುಳ್ಳು ಒಂದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡುವಾಗ ನಿಮಿಷದ ಮುಳ್ಳು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸುತ್ತು ಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಲೂಪ್ ಒಳಗಿನ ಲೂಪ್ ಹೀಗೆಯೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A loop placed inside the body of another loop is called a nested loop. For every single iteration of the outer loop, the inner loop runs through all of its iterations. So if the outer loop runs m times and the inner loop n times, the inner body runs m × n times. Python allows any combination: for inside for, while inside for, and so on.

points.en: Inner loop completes for each outer iteration
Any loop can be nested inside any other

narration.en: A loop placed inside the body of another loop is called a nested loop. For every single iteration of the outer loop, the inner loop runs through all of its iterations. So if the outer loop runs m times and the inner loop n times, the inner body runs m × n times. Python allows any combination: for inside for, while inside for, and so on.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಲೂಪ್‌ನ ದೇಹದೊಳಗೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಲೂಪ್ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದು ನೆಸ್ಟೆಡ್ ಲೂಪ್. ಹೊರಗಿನ ಲೂಪ್‌ನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗೆ ಒಳಗಿನ ಲೂಪ್ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಓಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಒಟ್ಟು m × n ಬಾರಿ.

title.en: On the board: Outer and inner loops as a grid

say.en: Let the outer loop give the rows, i from 1 to 3, and the inner loop the columns, j from 1 to 4.
Row 1: i stays 1 while j runs 1, 2, 3, 4. The inner loop finishes before i changes.
Then i becomes 2, and j starts again from 1. The same for i equal to 3.
Count the boxes: 3 rows times 4 columns makes 12 runs of the inner body.

narration.en: We lay out the iterations of a nested loop as a grid of rows and columns.

caption.en: Each Step runs the inner body once. For every value of i the inner loop runs all its values of j, then print() starts a new row.
caption.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಒಳಗಿನ ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. i ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಿನ ಲೂಪ್ ಎಲ್ಲ j ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

tryThis.kn: ತ್ರಿಕೋನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸಿ. ಸಾಲು i ಯಲ್ಲಿ i + 1 ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ ಏಕೆ?

body.en: Nested loops are used to print patterns. The outer loop usually controls the rows and the inner loop prints the items of one row; print() with no argument after the inner loop moves to the next line. If the inner loop’s range depends on the outer variable, such as range(1, i + 1), each row gets longer and we get a triangle with 1 + 2 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2 items.

points.en: Outer loop → rows; inner loop → items in a row
print(..., end=" ") stays on the line; print() ends it
Triangle of n rows: n(n + 1)/2 items
